final_answer.key_evidence_summary: All 51 pods in train-ticket are Running 1/1 with no restart outliers, so this is not a scheduling/startup/probe fault. Alerts and entry-caller error logs both point downstream: ts-inside-payment-service logs '500 ... path:/api/v1/paymentservice/payment' (62x) and ts-preserve-service logs 'getTickets failed' (90x) plus '500 ... path:/api/v1/orderservice/order' (7x). Following the dependency edges to the callees, the first observation != expectation is at the shared database: ts-payment-service and ts-order-service both emit 'SQL Error: 1290, SQLState: HY000' / 'The MySQL server is running with the --read-only option so it cannot execute this statement' (62x and 44x respectively), followed by JpaSystemException 'could not execute statement'. Two independent services failing with the identical DB-level signature places the break in the shared MySQL rather than in any single app's connection config. Config face: GetAppYAML(ts-payment-service) resolves envFrom secret ts-payment-mysql -> PAYMENT_MYSQL_HOST=tsdb-mysql-leader, port 3306; Service tsdb-mysql-leader (selector app=tsdb-mysql, role=leader) has the single endpoint 172.20.2.41:3306 (= tsdb-mysql-0). Event surface corroborates the DB: tsdb-mysql StatefulSet pods were repeatedly recreated (Killing -> SuccessfulCreate at ~58m/42m/27m/11m) with 'Warning Unhealthy: Readiness probe failed: ERROR 2002 (HY000): Can't connect to local MySQL server' and 'container is in CONTAINER_EXITED state', and the instance came up as a replication slave/read-only member ('Slave I/O thread ... connected to master qc_repl@tsdb-mysql-0...'), so the serving instance rejects writes. Root cause: the shared Train-Ticket MySQL (tsdb-mysql) is in read-only mode; affected apps are victims of the propagated write failures.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-payment-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-payment-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-payment-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-payment-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-payment-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-payment-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 19001
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 300m
            memory: 400Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2000Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 19001
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-payment-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 19001
  selector:
    app: ts-payment-service
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-payment-mysql
type: Opaque
stringData:
  PAYMENT_MYSQL_HOST: tsdb-mysql-leader
  PAYMENT_MYSQL_PORT: '3306'
  PAYMENT_MYSQL_DATABASE: ts
  PAYMENT_MYSQL_USER: ts
  PAYMENT_MYSQL_PASSWORD: Ts_123456
